contract.scope:
# Premeasurement contract: permutate

Preserve the original million-sample DVC dataset, size8 source setting, ten blocks ×250 threads, 2500 parallel streams, ceil(10000/2500) batch cap and source early-stop/controller/CPU bzip compression stage. Additional fixed2048-value eight-bit and4096-bit controls exercise both shuffle/statistical entry pairs; not a whole NIST conformance or randomness-certification study.
